Definition: of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite:--Meleas.
BiblicalUsage: Meleas is a name in Luke's genealogy, one link between Nathan and David. Luke 3:31 names Melea the son of Menan, in the line that runs from David through Nathan to Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no link in the line to Christ is wasted, even the names we meet only once.
